summary_en: Riken Technos executed a block trade to acquire 850,000 shares at 2,398 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 6, 2026, totaling approximately 2.04 billion yen (0.7% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock). This execution is part of the 4 million share buyback program authorized on July 31, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On November 6, 2026, Riken Technos Corporation executed a block trade acquisition of up to 850,000 shares of common stock at a fixed price of 2,398 yen per share through off-hours trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange using the ToSTNeT-3 system. The total consideration for this execution was approximately 2.043 billion yen. This represents 0.7% of shares outstanding (excluding treasury stock), calculated as 850,000 shares divided by an implied outstanding base of approximately 121.4 million shares.

This execution is part of a broader buyback program authorized by the board of directors on July 31, 2026, which permits the acquisition of up to 4 million shares for a maximum aggregate consideration of 8.8 billion yen during the period from August 3 through December 30, 2026. As of November 5, 2026, the company had cumulatively acquired 2,564,300 shares for an aggregate consideration of 6,216,647,600 yen, representing a 64.1% execution rate of the authorized program. The ToSTNeT-3 transaction was executed at the closing price as of the announcement date (including final special quotations) and was limited to the specified trading session on November 6, 2026 at 8:45 a.m. Results were publicly disclosed immediately following the completion of the trading session.
